# Fixture Knowledge Base

A synthetic stand-in for the evidence corpus, written for the lint tests. It
copies no real document; it only has the shape the contract checks.

Upcoming deployments use their own ids (UPC_ prefix) and are never cited.

| Evidence Strength | Record Count Threshold | Documents |
|---|---|---|
| HIGH | 100+ historical records | 3 |
| MEDIUM | 20–99 historical records | 0 |
| LOW | 5–19 historical records | 0 |
